_doc: Market square (GDD 4.5.1-4.5.3, 4.5.6, 4.5.7). Figures [balance]. stalls: id -> what it sells (the market_stall values of data/items) and where it is: outdoor stalls sit on the map (data/maps/<map>.json "stalls"), shops are a building type with interior. price_buy = round(base_price × quality_mult[quality] × demand × buy_price_mult of the difficulty); price_sell = round(price_buy × sell_ratio). Demand per item in [min, max], starts at start, drops drop_per_unit per unit sold to the market by anybody, recovers recover_per_day at dawn towards rest. Contract deliveries do not touch demand. errand: buy and send to an own building, +surcharge over the purchase price (ledger category errands), arrives in hours of game time. board: the contract board (GDD 4.5.6).
_stalls_h12_doc: H12 (decided 2026-11-03, until the EA shops with interior): clothier (the Ropería of GDD 4.5.1, a shop with interior there) and goods (furniture, barrels and carved stone, not in 4.5.1) are outdoor stalls of the plaza for now. H12.2: apothecary (the Boticario of 4.5.1: bandages, salves, herbs and the doctor's bag), an outdoor stall on the east edge of the plaza for now.
